mapper.select: SELECT METRIC, MAX(MAX_V) MAX_V, MIN(MIN_V) MIN_V, ROUND(SUM(AVG_V * SAMPLE_COUNT) / SUM(SAMPLE_COUNT), 1) AVG_V, MAX(UPDATED_AT) UPDATED_AT FROM HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY WHERE STAT_DATE = #{statDate} AND METRIC IN ('HEART_RATE', 'SPO2', 'TEMPERATURE') GROUP BY METRIC
SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN LIST_TYPE = 'KEY' THEN 1 END), 0) KEY_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN LIST_TYPE = 'TODAY' AND EXPIRE_DATE >= #{today} THEN 1 END), 0) TODAY_COUNT FROM WATCH_LIST
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEVICE WHERE STATUS = 1
SELECT CATEGORY, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(CARD_CODE, 'imei:' || DEVICE_IMEI)) PERSONS FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE OCCURRED_AT >= #{dayStart} AND OCCURRED_AT < #{dayEnd} AND CATEGORY <> 'OTHER' GROUP BY CATEGORY

SELECT g.CARD_CODE, g.DEVICE_IMEI, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, g.EVENT_COUNT, g.OCCUR_TOTAL, g.LAST_AT, g.LAST_CODE, g.LAST_VAL, g.LAST_SRC FROM (SELECT NVL(CARD_CODE, 'imei:' || DEVICE_IMEI) WHO, MAX(CARD_CODE) CARD_CODE, MAX(DEVICE_IMEI) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY LAST_OCCURRED_AT, ID) DEVICE_IMEI, COUNT(*) EVENT_COUNT, SUM(OCCUR_COUNT) OCCUR_TOTAL, MAX(LAST_OCCURRED_AT) LAST_AT, MAX(CODE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY LAST_OCCURRED_AT, ID) LAST_CODE, MAX(VAL_TEXT) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY LAST_OCCURRED_AT, ID) LAST_VAL, MAX(SRC) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY LAST_OCCURRED_AT, ID) LAST_SRC FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE CATEGORY = #{category} AND OCCURRED_AT >= #{dayStart} AND OCCURRED_AT < #{dayEnd} GROUP BY NVL(CARD_CODE, 'imei:' || DEVICE_IMEI)) g LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = g.CARD_CODE ORDER BY g.LAST_AT DESC, g.WHO OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT e.ID, e.CARD_CODE, e.DEVICE_IMEI, p.PERSON_NAME, e.CODE, e.OCCURRED_AT, e.LAST_OCCURRED_AT, e.OCCUR_COUNT FROM ALERT_EVENT e LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = e.CARD_CODE WHERE e.SRC = 'DEVICE' AND e.CATEGORY = 'OTHER' AND e.OCCURRED_AT >= #{dayStart} AND e.OCCURRED_AT < #{dayEnd} ORDER BY e.LAST_OCCURRED_AT DESC, e.ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT w.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT FROM WATCH_LIST w LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE WHERE w.LIST_TYPE = 'KEY' ORDER BY w.ADDED_AT DESC, w.ID DESC
SELECT SNAPSHOT_TIME, IN_WELL_COUNT FROM POS_HEADCOUNT_SERIES WHERE SNAPSHOT_TIME >= #{from} AND SNAPSHOT_TIME < #{to} ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_TIME

WITH w AS (SELECT CARD_CODE FROM V_POS_IN_WELL), a AS (SELECT DISTINCT CARD_CODE FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE CARD_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY <> 'OTHER' AND LAST_OCCURRED_AT >= #{activeSince} AND OCCURRED_AT >= #{activeDayStart})
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w) IN_WELL, x.EXPECTED, x.ONLINE_COUNT, x.ONLINE_ALERT FROM (SELECT COUNT(d.IMEI) EXPECTED, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.LAST_SEEN_AT >= #{onlineSince} THEN 1 END), 0) ONLINE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.LAST_SEEN_AT >= #{onlineSince} AND a.CARD_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0) ONLINE_ALERT FROM w JOIN DEVICE d ON d.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1 LEFT JOIN a ON a.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE) x

FROM V_POS_IN_WELL w LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN DEVICE d ON d.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1 LEFT JOIN POS_AREA ar ON ar.AREA_CODE = w.AREA_CODE
INSTR(p.PERSON_NAME, #{keyword}) > 0 OR INSTR(w.CARD_CODE, #{keyword}) > 0
mapper.select: SELECT CARD_CODE, PERSON_NAME, DEPT, AREA_NAME, WATCH_STATE FROM (SELECT w.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, ar.AREA_NAME, CASE WHEN d.IMEI IS NULL THEN 'UNBOUND' WHEN d.LAST_SEEN_AT >= #{onlineSince} THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END WATCH_STATE ) ORDER BY CASE WATCH_STATE WHEN 'ONLINE' THEN 0 WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, PERSON_NAME, CARD_CODE OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, s.STEPS FROM STEP_DAILY s LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = s.CARD_CODE WHERE s.STAT_DATE = #{statDate} ORDER BY s.STEPS DESC, p.PERSON_NAME, s.CARD_CODE FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
